audience: businesses that send SMS and MMS messages from SMSBlast

useCases.title: Check the balance and sender status
useCases.text: Read the prepaid balance, the default sender number and whether that sender is verified.

useCases.title: Send an SMS or MMS
useCases.text: Show the sender, recipients and text to the user. Then send one message to up to 100 recipients. Sent messages cannot be recalled.

useCases.title: Stop messages to a contact
useCases.text: Opt a contact out when the contact asks to stop. Repeating the call is safe.
